items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: I have quite a few of the records that you made with Johnny and with Tommy Ladner.

ctx.x: Well, Johnny played clarinet with me after my clarinet player died.
Oh, Bryant. Yes, Jimmy O' Bryant. I have quite a few of the records that you made with Johnny and with Tommy Ladner.
I have a bunch of them there.
